summary: Each play uses one strategy plugin, and different plays can use different ones. The default is linear. You can change it with ANSIBLE_STRATEGY, strategy in [defaults] or the strategy play keyword, for example strategy: debug.
questions: How do I let hosts run through tasks independently instead of in lockstep?
What is the default execution strategy?
Can different plays in one playbook use different strategies?
How do I set the strategy for a single play?
How do I enable the debug strategy?

answer_card.title: Choosing an execution strategy
answer_card.answer_md:
Default is `linear`. One strategy per play, but plays can differ.

```shell
export ANSIBLE_STRATEGY=free
```

```ini
[defaults]
strategy=linear
```

Per play:

```yaml
- hosts: all
  strategy: debug
  tasks:
    - copy:
        src: myhosts
        dest: /etc/hosts
```
